question: What frame rate and bitrate does the Mimi codec operate at, and how many quantizers does it use?
answer: To improve the ability of Mimi to encode speech into compact representations while reconstructing high-quality audio, we add Transformer modules in the bottleneck, one right before quantization and one after [Moshi: a speech-text foundation model for real-time dialogue, arXiv:2410.00037v1, pp. 10-11, Section 3.3.1 Architecture]. question: Why does scaled dot-product attention divide the dot products by the square root of d_k?
answer: 3.2.1 Scaled Dot-Product Attention We call our particular attention "Scaled Dot-Product Attention" (Figure 2) [Attention Is All You Need, arXiv:1706.03762v7, p. 4, Section 3.2.1 Scaled Dot-Product Attention]. The input consists of queries and keys of dimension dk, and values of dimension dv [Attention Is All You Need, arXiv:1706.03762v7, p. 4, Section 3.2.1 Scaled Dot-Product Attention]. We compute the dot products of the query with all keys, divide each by √dk, and apply a softmax function to obtain the weights on the values [Attention Is All You Need, arXiv:1706.03762v7, p. 4, Section 3.2.1 Scaled Dot-Product Attention]. In practice, we compute the attention function on a set of queries simultaneously, packed together into a matrix Q [Attention Is All You Need, arXiv:1706.03762v7, p. 4, Section 3.2.1 Scaled Dot-Product Attention]. The keys and values are also packed together into matrices K and V  [Attention Is All You Need, arXiv:1706.03762v7, p. 4, Section 3.2.1 Scaled Dot-Product Attention].

answer: 3.2.1 Scaled Dot-Product Attention We call our particular attention "Scaled Dot-Product Attention" (Figure 2) [Attention Is All You Need, arXiv:1706.03762v7, p. 4, Section 3.2.1 Scaled Dot-Product Attention]. The input consists of queries and keys of dimension dk, and values of dimension dv [Attention Is All You Need, arXiv:1706.03762v7, p. 4, Section 3.2.1 Scaled Dot-Product Attention]. We compute the dot products of the query with all keys, divide each by √dk, and apply a softmax function to obtain the weights on the values [Attention Is All You Need, arXiv:1706.03762v7, p. 4, Section 3.2.1 Scaled Dot-Product Attention]. In practice, we compute the attention function on a set of queries simultaneously, packed together into a matrix Q [Attention Is All You Need, arXiv:1706.03762v7, p. 4, Section 3.2.1 Scaled Dot-Product Attention]. The keys and values are also packed together into matrices K and V  [Attention Is All You Need, arXiv:1706.03762v7, p. 4, Section 3.2.1 Scaled Dot-Product Attention].
